title: Composition I
notes: UIUC's semester 1 reads 'Composition I or General Education (choose a Humanities or Social/Behavioral Science course)' (4 hours) and semester 2 'General Education (...) or Composition I course' (3 hours): Composition I goes in one semester and a gen-ed course in the other.
